subject: Environmental Studies
stem: A simple optical device using two plane mirrors placed parallel to each other at 45°, allowing a person to see over an obstacle or around a corner (famously used in submarines to view the surface), is called a:
explanation: A periscope uses two plane mirrors (or prisms) to reflect light through a right angle twice, letting the viewer see objects out of direct line of sight — distinct from a telescope (views distant objects using lenses/curved mirrors) or microscope (magnifies tiny nearby objects).
